subject: How to run a shiny application on shiny server/shinyapps using GitHib

messages.author: 851baabb324f1dd1
messages.subject: How to run a shiny application on shiny server/shinyapps using GitHib
parts:
The idea is pretty simple but couldn't find any explanation...it's pretty similar to using runGitHub function for local applications.

Basically I'd like to have my ui.R/server.R files sitting on GitHub and deploy an application on Shiny Server or ShinyApps based on those files so that whenever I commit some changes to GitHub they are automatically reflected into my Shiny application.

Thanks,

Paolo

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: How to run a shiny application on shiny server/shinyapps using GitHib
parts:
That's a great idea, Paolo. We're working on similar features for Shiny Server Pro right now that we hope to integrate into the RStudio IDE, but I don't know that we'd planned for this specific request. I'll make sure we keep this in mind moving forward.

(If you're looking to hack a solution together yourself, this concept is called "continuous integration" in software circles, and I imagine you'll find some tools out there that could help you accomplish this now if you're willing to do a little leg-work.)

Jeff
